SharedFlowBundle.name: ISAM-Common-CompressAssertion
SharedFlowBundle.Description:
Reusable building block: zips + base64-encodes saml.assertion.xml when compressSaml is true, otherwise just base64-encodes it. Used by every SAML-bearing type (ISAM-SAML-Light, ISAM-SAML-User, ISAM-SAML-TP, ISAM-SAML-Technical, ISAM-JWT-SAML); NOT by ISAM-JWT-Token (type 6).
INPUT variables: saml.assertion.xml string, required compressSaml boolean-ish, required (resolved by the caller from its own KVM default / per-request override before this FlowCallout)
OUTPUT variables: saml.assertion.output string (base64, zipped or plain) saml.assertion.compressed boolean saml.assertion.compress.error string, only set on exception
